# Safety checks

## Before you begin

- Disconnect the power supply
    1. Verify the indicator is dark
        1. Wait for the capacitor to discharge
- The interlock will not release until the residual charge has fully dissipated, which can take several minutes in a cold enclosure.
    1. Confirm the interlock has released

## Connector types

1. spade
2. ferrule
3. ring
4. blade
5. pin

Coolant is CO2 at 25 m3 per hour.
